review_method.entrance_windows: All ten strict entrance-ray windows were reviewed at their original 1440x1680 crop size: two cross-collection references and reciprocal prev/anchor/next query frames per episode.
review_method.allowed_evidence: Downloaded pixels, frozen OSM target-way/main-entrance geometry, frozen item pose metadata, and deterministic entrance-ray projection only.
review_method.forbidden_evidence: No OCR, CLIP, DINOv2, patch matcher, score, rank, threshold decision, or other learned-router output was viewed before this truth file was frozen.

episodes.observation: Both references and all three query frames show the same Euromaster service-building facade. The large EUROMASTER wordmark, blue structural bays, green revision band, garage doors, and adjacent parked vehicles provide continuous target evidence across the two collections.

Both references and all three query frames show the same Maladrerie library frontage. The curved beige facade, recessed glazed entrance, eye-shaped wall emblem, orange-and-white Bibliotheque Maladrerie sign, windows, and forecourt vegetation remain continuously identifiable.

claim_boundary.allowed: Human-visible same-target positive truth for this frozen two-episode, new-city, target-way/item-disjoint, same-provider cross-collection panel.
claim_boundary.not_allowed: The review does not prove portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint quality, arrival, handoff, user benefit, provider-disjoint generalization, fully pixel-unseen generalization, deployment performance, or safety.
